item.title: Delhi High Court grants bail to accused in NDPS case involving trafficking of psychotropic substances to USA
item.description: “No recovery of any contraband has been effected from the personal or conscious possession of the accused. The recoveries were made from the premises of third-party i.e. courier companies upon the disclosure statements of the co — accused” The post Delhi High Court grants bail to accused in NDPS case involving trafficking of psychotropic substances to USA appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Informing role and grounds of arrest sufficient in NDPS case with no contraband recovery; quantity need not be conveyed: Kerala HC
item.description: “The requirement of informing the person arrested of the grounds of arrest is not a formality but a mandatory statutory and constitutional requirement, and the non-compliance with Article 22(1) is a violation of a fundamental right and of the right to personal liberty guaranteed by Article 21 of the Constitution.” The post Informing role and grounds of arrest sufficient in NDPS case with no contraband recovery; quantity need not be conveyed: Kerala HC appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Section 108 BNS| No abetment of suicide without proximate positive action by accused: Punjab & Haryana HC grants bail to wife in husband’s suicide case
item.description: “It is well settled proposition of law that bail is the rule, and jail is an exception and pre-trial incarceration of the wife should not be a replica of post-conviction sentencing.” The post Section 108 BNS| No abetment of suicide without proximate positive action by accused: Punjab & Haryana HC grants bail to wife in husband’s suicide case appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: CCI imposes Rs 27 Crores penalty on Intel Corp. for abuse of dominance through India-specific warranty policy on boxed microprocessors
item.description: CCI noted that warranty is an important factor when buying a boxed microprocessor, as it protects against defects and gives consumers confidence. Intel’s data from 2016—2021 shows failures do occur, so denying warranty in India for products bought abroad harms consumers and creates adverse effects on competition. The post CCI imposes Rs 27 Crores penalty on Intel Corp. for abuse of dominance through India-specific warranty policy on boxed microprocessors appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Employment or earning of wife alone not a ground to deny maintenance: Allahabad High Court
item.description: “The Court is unable to accept the submission that mere employment or earning of the wife is, by itself, a ground to deny maintenance. The object of Section 125 CrPC is not merely to prevent destitution, but to ensure that the wife is able to live with dignity, consistent with the status of the husband.” The post Employment or earning of wife alone not a ground to deny maintenance: Allahabad High Court appeared first on SCC Times.
